The Chinese characters for Ariana

As a transliteration, Ariana is usually written 阿里安娜 (Ā lǐ ān nà). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

阿
Ā
a prefix, hill
里
lǐ
inside, a mile
安
ān
peace, safe
娜
nà
elegant (in names)

Origin and meaning

With Greek origins, Ariana is usually read as “most holy (from Ariadne)”.

About the name Ariana

From the Greek Ariadne, and the name of the singer Ariana Grande.

As a gift or a tattoo

Because it means “most holy (from Ariadne)”, an Ariana calligraphy print makes a thoughtful gift for someone who loves the name or its meaning.
